# Class booking — spec

A small studio lets members book fitness classes online.

## First milestone (M1)
- Members see the week's classes with free spots.
- A member books a class; a full class cannot be booked.
- A member cancels a booking; the spot is freed.
- Bookings are paid when made.

## Not yet
- Waitlists, instructor accounts, recurring bookings.

## Stack
Node 20, Express, SQLite. Deployed to one small VPS.
